snippet.title: POOF - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
POOF is a trippy-stealth multiplayer adventure.

Play with your friends as Gooblins, a cheeky and mischievous bunch of creatures. Run, hide, seek and fight in a twisted world of a child's imagination. Abuse your voice chat - the louder you scream, the faster you POOF!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4323070/POOF/

Music by Jan Skorupa, Szymon Śniegocki
Voiceover by Ravin Wong
